    Finite subcovers by inversion loci on families of representations #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_finite_inversion_cover (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] {X : Type u_1} {J : Type u_2} (M : X → FGModuleCat R) {d : ℕ} (hd : ∀ (x : X), Module.finrank k ↑(M x).obj = d) (P : J → TwoTerm R) (hc : ∀ (x : X), ∃ (j : J), (P j).InvertedOn (M x).obj) :
    ∃ (t : Finset J), ∀ (x : X), ∃ j ∈ t, (P j).InvertedOn (M x).obj

    For a family of modules of one ground dimension, any cover by loci inverting projective differentials already has a finite subcover. No topology on the indexing set or rationality assumption on the points is needed.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_infinite_fixed_class_chart_of_pointwise_inversion (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] {J : Type u_1} (θ : Weight (FGModuleCat R)) (c : GrothendieckGroup (FGModuleCat R)) (hi : (stableClassesOfClass θ c).Infinite) (P : J → TwoTerm R) (hs : ∀ (j : J) (M : FGModuleCat R), θ.IsStable M → (TwoTerm.eulerWeight k (P j)).IsStable M) (hc : ∀ (M : FGModuleCat R), GrothendieckGroup.of M = c → θ.IsStable M → ∃ (j : J), (P j).InvertedOn M.obj) :
    ∃ (j : J), (TwoTerm.stableInvertingClasses k (P j) ∩ stableClassesOfClass θ c).Infinite

    For an infinite stable family of fixed class, a pointwise choice of inverting differential preserving stability yields one infinite stable chart.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_infinite_stable_chart_of_pointwise_inversion (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] {J : Type u_1} (θ : Weight (FGModuleCat R)) (c : GrothendieckGroup (FGModuleCat R)) (hi : (stableClassesOfClass θ c).Infinite) (P : J → TwoTerm R) (hs : ∀ (j : J) (M : FGModuleCat R), θ.IsStable M → (TwoTerm.eulerWeight k (P j)).IsStable M) (hc : ∀ (M : FGModuleCat R), GrothendieckGroup.of M = c → θ.IsStable M → ∃ (j : J), (P j).InvertedOn M.obj) :
    ∃ (j : J), (TwoTerm.stableInvertingClasses k (P j)).Infinite

    Dropping the fixed class condition gives an infinite stable chart.
